summary: Penobscot County, ME crow's nest lookout on Spoon Mountain, built by the Maine Forest Service in 1916, replaced by a 50-foot steel tower in 1936, removed 1978; listed as gone.

facts.design: crow's nest on a wood tower built 1916; 50-foot steel tower from 1936
facts.status_note: Maine Memory says the structure was removed in 1978; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone

A 15-foot section was added; the record says it was raised by 15 feet to a height of 30 feet

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the 1916 height: the slideshow says the wood tower was 30 feet when built and gained 15 feet in 1920; record 19132 says it was raised 15 feet in 1920 to reach 30 feet. The story reports both. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Maine Chapter Facebook post, seen only as a search snippet and not fetched, describes the first tower as a log tower and says a 1920 log tower replaced it; not used because the page could not be read. Nothing found on fires, public access, or what remains on the site today. Coordinates on the FFLOS list (46.29582, -68.65721) match the brief.
